# Game art list

<!-- Generated by `npm run art:list` from art/catalog.json. Edit the catalog, not this file. -->

Everything visual in QuestLayer that can be replaced by a generated image, what it is for, how big it must be and a prompt to generate it. Drop a finished file into the folder with the exact name and it replaces the placeholder on the next build. Nothing else changes: if a file is missing, the current art stays.

## How to drop files in

1. Generate the image with the house style below plus the item's prompt.
2. Remove the background (PNG/WebP with transparency) and crop to the size in the table. SVG is fine for flat art.
3. Save it as `art/<folder>/<name>.png` (or `.webp` / `.svg`), lower-case, exactly the name in the table, e.g. `art/actors/merchant.png`.
4. Run `npm run art:check`. It lists unknown names (typos), wrong formats, too small or too heavy files.
5. Commit and deploy as usual. Vite fingerprints the files, so phones get the new art right away.

Priority: **1** = biggest visible win (logo, NPCs, monsters, map objects), **2** = next, **3** = optional.

## House style (paste before every prompt)

> QuestLayer game art: cute, friendly 2D fantasy-adventure illustration for a mobile map game. Chunky, instantly readable silhouette, thick dark plum outline (#1A0335), soft cel shading with two tones per colour, light from the upper left, a thin warm rim light. Palette: lavender #B9A6FF, hot pink #FA34F3, teal #37F4F1, mint #51FFA8, gold #FFD01F, deep purple #230E4F, cream #FFFAF0. Characters are QuestLayer's own round ghost folk with big glossy eyes and small pink cheeks. Single subject, centred, fully visible with a little empty margin, isolated on a transparent background, no text, no frame, no ground shadow.

**Negative prompt:** photorealistic, realistic 3D render, noise, text, letters, logo text, watermark, signature, busy background, scenery, floor, cast shadow on background, cropped limbs, cut-off edges, tiny details that disappear at 48 px, thin outlines, characters or logos from existing games or brands

Palette: ink `#1A0335`, deepPurple `#230E4F`, lavender `#B9A6FF`, hotPink `#FA34F3`, teal `#37F4F1`, mint `#51FFA8`, gold `#FFD01F`, cream `#FFFAF0`.

Rarity accents: common `#9A8CAB`, rare `#37F4F1`, epic `#B48CFF`, legendary `#FFD01F`.

Tips: generate at 2–4× the target size and scale down; keep one seed/reference image per family (NPCs, monsters, objects, Auras) so the set looks consistent; if the generator cannot do transparency, ask for a flat `#00FF00` background and remove it. Export PNG with alpha or WebP (quality ~85).

## Logo and app icon

Folder: `art/brand/` · Size: 512×512 (SVG preferred) · Formats: svg, png, webp · Max ~120 KB each

Square mark that still reads at 32 px. Shown in the top-left logo button and on the 'Install the app' card; the compact phone header will use it too.

| File | What | Used for | Now | Prio | Prompt |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `art/brand/app-icon.png` | App icon (install card) | Picture on the 'Install QuestLayer' card. Falls back to brand/logo. | /icon.svg (a small cream ghost on a purple rounded square). | 3 | The QuestLayer logo mark from brand/logo placed on a deep purple (#230E4F) rounded square with a soft lavender inner glow, 512×512, flat vector, no text. |
| `art/brand/wordmark.png` | Wordmark (about 900×280 (trimmed), SVG preferred) · *needs hook* | 'QuestLayer' lettering for the phone header, welcome screen and how-it-works page. Needs a small hook in the header once the compact header lands. | Plain text. | 2 | Wordmark 'QuestLayer' (exact spelling) in a rounded, chunky, playful game font, cream letters with a thick #1A0335 outline, a small hot-pink map pin after the last letter, transparent background. Simple enough to redraw as SVG. |

## PWA / home-screen icons (replace in public/)

Folder: `public/` · Size: see each · Formats: png, svg

These are read by the phone when the game is installed, so they are not in art/. Overwrite the files in public/ with the same name and size. Maskable: keep the mark inside the centre 80 % circle; apple-touch: no transparency.

| File | What | Used for | Now | Prio | Prompt |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `public/icon.svg` | Browser tab icon (SVG, 64×64 viewBox) | Browser tab and bookmarks. | Small cream ghost on purple. | 2 | Same as brand/app-icon, simplified for 16-32 px: only the ghost-in-pin silhouette on a purple rounded square. |
| `public/icon-192.png` | App icon 192 (192×192 PNG) | Android home screen. | Placeholder ghost. | 2 | Export of brand/app-icon at 192×192. |
| `public/icon-512.png` | App icon 512 (512×512 PNG) | Android splash and store-like surfaces. | Placeholder ghost. | 2 | Export of brand/app-icon at 512×512. |
| `public/icons/maskable-512.png` | Maskable icon (512×512 PNG, no transparency) | Android adaptive icon (gets cropped to a circle or squircle). | Placeholder. | 2 | brand/logo centred inside the middle 80 % (410 px circle) on a full-bleed deep purple #230E4F background. |
| `public/icons/apple-touch-180.png` | Apple touch icon (180×180 PNG, no transparency) | iPhone home screen. | Placeholder. | 2 | brand/app-icon at 180×180 with an opaque purple background (iOS rounds the corners itself). |

## Player character

Folder: `art/player/` · Size: 384×448 (or SVG) · Formats: png, webp, svg · Max ~150 KB each

Replaces the default explorer everywhere in 2D (map pawn, profile, inventory, wardrobe, notes, welcome). The optional 3D map body (Settings → 3D) keeps the Aavegotchi GLB. Auras float above the head and glow under the hem, so leave ~10 % empty space above and below.

| File | What | Used for | Now | Prio | Prompt |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `art/player/explorer.png` | Default explorer | Every new player's look until they connect an original Aavegotchi. | Official Aavegotchi starter template SVG (allowed, but not QuestLayer's own). | 3 | Full-body QuestLayer explorer: a small round cream ghost (#FFFAF0) with big glossy dark eyes, pink cheeks, tiny stubby hands, a teal scarf and a little brown satchel, wavy hem at the bottom, front view facing the viewer, cheerful and curious. QuestLayer house style, transparent background. |

## Auras (wearables)

Folder: `art/auras/` · Size: above 192×96 (2:1), below 224×80 (2.8:1) · Formats: png, webp, svg · Max ~60 KB each

Only the effect, without the ghost. The game places 'above' Auras over the head and 'below' Auras on the ground. If a player wears an edition in the other slot, add <id>-above or <id>-below; otherwise the same file is fitted into the box. The game adds a gentle bob; no frames needed. NFT media on NEAR (public/aura-*.svg) stay unchanged on purpose: minted media must not change.

## Place badges

Folder: `art/badges/` · Size: 256×256 · Formats: png, webp, svg · Max ~60 KB each

Round medal face shown at 52 px in the badge book and 96 px in the detail. Draw a full circle; the ring colour around it still shows the rarity. Player-made badges keep their emoji (players pick them).

| File | What | Used for | Now | Prio | Prompt |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `art/badges/peak.png` | Peak badge | All mountain-peak place badges (13). | ⛰️ emoji in a ring. | 2 | Round enamel pin badge: a snowy mountain peak with a tiny flag on top, lavender sky, gold rim. QuestLayer house style, transparent outside the circle, no text. |
| `art/badges/viewpoint.png` | Viewpoint badge | Viewpoint badges (6). | 🔭 emoji. | 2 | Round enamel pin badge: a small brass telescope on a rocky ledge looking at a sunset valley, gold rim. QuestLayer house style, transparent outside the circle, no text. |
| `art/badges/landmark.png` | Landmark badge | Landmark badges (28). | 🏛️ emoji. | 2 | Round enamel pin badge: a classic columned monument with a glowing map pin above it, gold rim. QuestLayer house style, transparent outside the circle, no text. |
| `art/badges/city.png` | City badge | Bigger-city badges (22). | 🏙️ emoji. | 2 | Round enamel pin badge: a cosy skyline of rooftops, a church tower and a castle, night sky with stars, gold rim. QuestLayer house style, transparent outside the circle, no text. |
| `art/badges/<badge-id>` | Unique badge for one place (optional) | Any id from server/data/place-badges.json, e.g. peak-snezka, view-pravcicka-brana, city-plzen. Wins over the kind badge. | Kind emoji. | 3 | Round enamel pin badge showing <the place's real silhouette, e.g. Sněžka's summit chapel>, gold rim, no text. |

## How it works in code

- At build time (Vite `import.meta.glob`) `src/art-overrides.ts` registers the welcome-screen art (logo, coin, player) and `src/art-world.ts`, which rides the map chunk, registers the rest in `src/art-registry.ts`. This keeps the welcome screen inside its JS budget.
- Each placeholder asks `artUrl(key)` first: logo (`BrandLogo`), player (`STARTER_SPRITE`), NPC/monster map sprites and sheets (`actorSprite`, `createActorScene`), dialog portraits (`NpcSheet`), Auras (`AuraSprite`, `auraMarkup`), map/list objects (`GameObjectArt`, `gameObjectMarkup`, map coin and street-find icons) and place badges (`BadgeBook`).
- Missing file = current art. NFT media already minted on NEAR (`public/aura-*.svg`, explorer cover) never change.
- `tests/art-catalog.test.mjs` keeps the catalog in step with the game data and this file in step with the catalog.

71 named files in total.
